Parties to the Agreement: Perlumi Chemicals, Inc and Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory CRADA number: FP00011696 CRADA Title: Bio-derived Hydrogen Peroxide Manufacturing from Pulp and Paper Waste Responsible Technical Contact at Berkeley Lab: Thomas Kirchstetter Name and Email Address of POC at Partner Company(ies): Chris Eiben ceiben@perlumi.com Sponsoring DOE Program Office(s): AMMTO LBNL Report Number: LBNL-2001705 OSTI Number: [SPO to complete] Joint Work Statement Funding Table showing DOE funding commitment: DOE Funding to LBNL $100,000 Participant Funding to LBNL - Participant In-Kind Contribution Value $100,000 Total of all Contributions $200,000 Provide a list of publications, conference papers, or other public releases of results, developed under this CRADA: none Provide a detailed list of all subject inventions, to include patent applications, copyrights, and trademarks: none Executive Summary of CRADA Work: The Perlumi project team worked on developing a novel route to hydrogen peroxide (H O ) 2 2 using methanol as the starting material. Global H O annual production is around 4.5 billion 2 2 kilos, and is valued around $2.5 billion dollars. The pulp and paper industry specifically buys about $1.5 billion of H O in aggregate as a green alternative to chlorine containing compounds 2 2 for pulp and paper bleaching. Perlumi’s novel H O production system has many technical advantages over the 2 2 incumbent anthraquinone process. First, the anthraquinone process’s ultimate feedstock is fossil natural gas, contributing to CO emissions.
